text: The ECB raised its deposit rate 25 basis points to 2.5%. Euro-zone inflation reached 3.3% in August, with energy inflation at 14.3%. The ECB projects core inflation above 2% through 2028 while identifying simultaneous upside inflation and downside growth risks.

meta.note: The policy path remains unspecified beyond the current 2.5% rate.

text: August PPI rose 0.4% m/m and 5.4% y/y. Final-demand energy prices increased 4.2%, including a 24.1% diesel rise, while goods rose 1.1% and services 0.1%. Core PPI increased 0.2%.

meta.note: Headline and core measures differ materially in the distribution of observed price pressure.

text: WTI exceeded $100 for the first time since May and Brent reached about $105. Gulf tanker attacks intensified while Hormuz traffic remained restricted; Houthi advances also increased pressure around Red Sea transit routes.

meta.note: Conflict-duration forecasts are excluded; the entry captures observed prices and transit constraints only.
